messages:
Maya: quick heads-up — I'm assembling the release notes for the next docs publish: feature announce for adaptive routing + a short migration guide for teams using pinned model variants. Need: updated SDK snippets, one migration checklist, and a Known Issues section.
Raj: on it. i'll scan the python & curl examples for breaking changes. can you drop the PR link?
Maya: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4826 — draft under `release/2024-05-adaptive-routing`. please comment inline if anything looks off.
Sophia: i'll take typescript + go snippets. flagging that the `retry_policy` param got renamed to `fallback_policy` in the runtime — will update examples.
Lee: FYI found two broken anchors in the migration guide: `#pin-models` and `#kv-cache-behavior`. i'll push a tiny redirect fix in the same PR unless you want a separate one.
Raj: saw the `fallback_policy` rename — tests failing in the python snippet because `fallback_policy` expects a dict not a string. i'll change sample to:

```
client.generate(model="kestrel-1", input="hi", fallback_policy={"type": "model_variant", "priority": ["fast","cheap"]})
```

Maya: perfect. also want a compact Known Issues bullet: "short bursts may see degraded latency under mixed sequence lengths; enable prefix cache for stable p99." can someone craft a one-liner with repro steps?
Sophia: i'll write the repro steps for TS: curl -> long context -> mixed-length parallel requests. will paste snippet.
Lee: adding a note about Dedicated rollouts — customers on Reserved Capacity might observe different fallback behavior because of pool pinning. short note added in the draft.
Raj: heads-up — the embed-streaming deprecation note still lives in a few pages. should we include a cross-link warning in the release notes? i can add a short callout.
Maya: yes, add a "breaking/behavior change" callout and link to the deprecation page. keep it terse.
Sophia: pasted TS repro snippet in PR comments.
Dev-docs-bot: New comment added to PR #4826 by Sophia: "TS repro snippet added — needs QA verification on staging docs site." :robot_face:
Raj: QA request — i'll run the updated python snippet against the staging runtime tomorrow and report token counts/latency.
Maya: thanks. final items: 1) update changelog short bullet for the console (rollouts), 2) ensure SDK examples across languages are parity, 3) add migration checklist with step numbers.
Lee: i'll draft the checklist (3 steps) and drop into the bottom of the migration doc.
Sophia: small nit — link text for "model variants" should point to the model catalog page, not model internals. fixed.
Raj: quick link-fix push: replaced absolute github raw links with docs-relative permalinks to avoid future drift.
Maya: timeline — i'd like to merge by EOD tomorrow; if any blockers ping me here. also, please add short reviewer approvals in the PR so i can merge.
Lee: approved after checklist commit.
Raj: approved pending QA results.
Sophia: approved.
Maya: awesome, thanks all. will schedule the doc publish and the Slack announcement once merged. :tada:
